# Vendored: K1ndl1ng parser and normaliser

`k1ndl1ng-ast`, `k1ndl1ng-parse` and `k1ndl1ng-norm` are copied unmodified from
https://github.com/F1R3FLY-io/campf1r3 at revision
b46e16c25458df8d2309554b316f3818a8e0a276 (`git archive`), under that
repository's Apache-2.0 licence (`LICENSE`). They are vendored so this
workspace builds on its own. To track campf1r3 instead, point the three
`[workspace.dependencies]` entries in the root `Cargo.toml` at a checkout
or at the git repository.
